meta.title: Eight friends, $2,600
meta.prompt: Eight friends are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Each person has a private limit on what they can pay and some things they cannot do, and nobody has said them yet. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and reach a plan and a split that all eight members can accept?
meta.context: Eight friends (Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom) are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

tiers.label: restaurants every meal (gluten-free and vegan menus)

events.text: Hey everyone! Let's get a starter plan on the table so we can tweak it together. I'm proposing a step-free, dietary-friendly option that stays well under $2,600: • Lodging A: lake house, 5 bedrooms, step-free — $1,100 • Transport C: one 12-seat van, 4-hour drive — $300 • Food A: restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus — $800 • Activities B: boat tour only — $280 Total = $2,480. With equal split that's $310 per person. Does step-free lodging and guaranteed gluten-free/vegan menus work for everyone? Any transport, food or activity preferences or budget limits I should know about before we lock it in?
